04:07 < jal0> hey filip

04:07 < Filip> happy thanksgiving

04:09 < Filip> what script ?
04:09 < jal0> (cd $BINUTILS_BLD; make 2>&1 | tee ../binutils-build.log) || exit
04:09 < jal0> cant get it to work
04:09 < jal0> it wont exit
04:09 < jal0> i believe its because of the tee
04:10 < jal0> basically, if the make fails i need the script to exit
04:11 < jal0> i'm using tee because i need the output to make to both go to a file and the screen
04:11 < Filip> hmm, looks sane at first sight, hold on
04:12 < jal0> i think the problem is that because tee is the last program in the subexpression, the exit never gets called
04:14 < Filip> (cd BEMON ; (make 2>&1 || exit) | tee ../log.txt)
04:15 < Filip> place the exit closer to the make ?
04:15 < jal0> i try is hand on
04:16 < jal0> nope, wont work, the exit only exits the subshell
04:17 < jal0> that why i had to place it outside of the () brackets
04:18 < Filip> maybe test $? to decide for exit ?
04:19 < jal0> problem is that when the subshell returns, it returns with the return value from tee, no make
04:19 < jal0> no=not
04:19 < Filip> move tee outside
04:20 < jal0> then the exit will only exit the subshell and not the scrip itself... or maybe i'm not sure what you mean?
04:21 < Filip> i see
04:23 < jal0> is there a way to save the return code of a program?
04:26 < Filip> (make 2>&1;export RC=$?)
04:27 < jal0> that will only work for subshells, parent shells wont see RC....?
04:28 < Filip> save the result in a temp file ?
04:28 < jal0> thats an idea
04:29 < Filip> maybe as last step in the make process, touch an 'ok' file
04:29 < Filip> or test if the binary has been made
04:30 < jal0> i try that.... have to think about it for a while, scripting is not my native language :)
04:32 < Filip> like all languages, you have to use it a lot 
04:41 < jal0> (cd $BINUTILS_BLD; make 2>&1 || echo $? > ../tmp) | tee ../binutils-build.log; [ `cat tmp` -eq "0" ] || exit
04:41 < jal0> ok... this seems to work
04:42 < jal0> wheww what a line :)
04:43 < Filip> making some kind of autobuild script for the toolchain ?
04:44 < jal0> just cleaning the one i have up. never realized it didn't exit on errors and would continue to build
